title: oil-motion
brief: An agent-oriented skill (SKILL.md) for designing and implementing web animations that respond to scroll, drag, pointer, touch, or state changes. The agent confirms keyframes, generates in-between motion with AI video models, then converts it into controllable web assets (MP4, alpha WebP sprite sheets) with quality checks for frame consistency and mobile performance; MIT-licensed. The README is primarily in Chinese (an English README.en.md exists), and the generation step needs external AI video services and API keys.
